{{Quote|And no one else has a T-14 hyperdrive. I promise you that.|Watto, to Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="TPM" />}}
The '''T-14''' was a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive generator]] commonly used aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] produced by the [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubian Design Collective]]. The [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-Type 327]] used by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was fitted with a class 1.8 T-14 hyperdrive.<ref name="FF6">{{FactFile|6|NAB 1-2|Naboo Royal Starship}}</ref>

During her escape from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Queen's ship was damaged, and the hyperdrive began leaking power. The vessel was forced to stop at [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] bartered with [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] to procure a new hyperdrive.<ref name="TPM" /> At that time, a T-14 hyperdrive generator was worth one hundred [[Gold/Legends|gold]] [[Peggat/Legends|peggats]], which was roughly equivalent to 4,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standard]].<ref name="TPM vg" />
